subject: Request: Trial license bump & credits due to integration hold
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@forgegate.io>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 09:12:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Quick sync & trial status

Hi Olga,

Thanks again for the product walkthrough yesterday — the team is excited about the latency profile and the model fallback behavior. We've run into an unexpected snag on our side: the connector that maps our user ID namespace into ForgeGate's data plane needs an extra week of refactor work. That blocks the end-to-end validation we planned for next Tuesday.

Two asks:
- Can Redwood extend the trial window by two weeks (we're currently on a 30-day POC license)?
- Would you be able to provide a small one-time sandbox credit bump (~$1,200) to keep the eval running while we complete the integration?

If helpful, I've attached a short extract from our logs showing the mapping error. We're prioritizing this and can share engineers on a call if it moves things along.

Appreciate any flexibility — this is a healthy potential deal but we need the functional end-to-end to validate.

Best,
Liam
Senior Platform Engineer
ForgeGate

Attachment: integration-log.txt (text)

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@forgegate.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 23 May 2027 14:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Quick sync & trial status

Hi Liam — thanks for the note and for sending the log extract. Sorry to hear about the mapping refactor pause. We want to keep momentum here. A few quick items so I can fast-track internally:

1) Confirmed ask: 2-week extension + one-time sandbox credit bump of ~$1,200.
2) Can you confirm which project/POC name we should attach credits to (so we update billing metadata)?
3) Any security/compliance checklist items outstanding that we should loop in early?

I'll loop in Marissa (CS lead) to confirm the operational details and our revenue partner for final sign-off. If you can share a brief note from your engineering lead (1–2 lines) confirming the delay, that helps speed approvals.

We can also propose a short joint debug session next week if you want Redwood eng to look at the errors in real time.

— Olga
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 11:27:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Quick sync & trial status — internal review

Olga / Rishi — quick internal note on the request from ForgeGate. Summary: 2-week trial extension + $1,200 sandbox bump. POC is active; ForgeGate is mid-PoC and has engaged our SDK team.

Assessment:
- ARR potential: medium-high, EU-based fintech-adjacent (compliant stack).
- Request cost: nominal ($1.2k) and acceptable under quota for AE discretionary credits.
- Risk: none from compliance perspective — no sensitive data exchange yet; they will keep test data in a sandbox.

Recommendation: Approve the 2-week extension and a one-time credit of $1,000 (counter-proposal) with the condition that ForgeGate provides an engineering confirmation note and a short acceptance checklist completed at the end of the extension. Rationale: preserves runway control while meeting the customer's need to validate end-to-end.

If you approve, I'll prepare the credit transaction and the short acceptance checklist (2 bullet items) for the customer to sign off on.

— Marissa
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference

Hi Liam — thanks for your patience while we reviewed this internally. Appreciate the quick context you sent earlier and the engineering note from your lead that you shared on Thursday.

We can do the following:
- Trial window extension: +14 days (new end date 2027-06-18).
- One-time sandbox credit: $1,000 applied to the ForgeGate POC account (internal deal RG-2027-2981).

Conditions:
1) Please have ForgeGate engineering confirm the integration blocker in one short sentence and reply-all. That confirmation is used for our audit trail.
2) Complete the two-item acceptance checklist we'll send (simple yes/no items: end-to-end validated; smoke test passed).

Next steps: Marissa will send the credit transaction and the acceptance checklist in a separate email (you'll see a HubSpot link and a DocuSign stub for the checklist). We'll also open a short debug window with our SDK engineer if you'd like live support during the extension — let me know preferred time slots.

Looking forward to getting you fully validated.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
